title: Simulator runtimes in system assets
explanation: This protected folder can contain registered Xcode runtimes and orphaned assets. Xcode can remove registered runtimes it marks as removable.
consequence: Runtimes Xcode still uses stay as they are, and orphans stay until a newer Xcode or runtime install cleans them up, or until a clean reinstall.

removal.instructions: Xcode › Settings › Components; Apple's only supported fix for orphans is a clean reinstall.
